name: Pentose Phosphate Pathway
description: See ecoli_pentose_phosphate_pathway - generates NADPH and ribose-5-P from G6P. Oxidative phase: G6P→6PG→Ru5P + 2 NADPH. Non-oxidative phase: reversible sugar interconversions via transketolase (Tkt) and transaldolase (Tal). Multiple modes: (1) NADPH production, (2) Ribose-5-P production, (3) Both, (4) Sugar phosphate recycling to glycolysis. High OR gates for pathway flexibility and operational modes.
scientificAccuracy: Based on biochemical studies of E. coli PPP.
